description.text: Teaching Objectives To help student obtain knowledge and ability of business management, economic management and enterprise management, and enable student to deal with all kinds of business management related work in all kinds of organizations. Main Courses Principles of Management, micro-economics, macro-economics, Management Information System, Statistics, Marketing, Economic Law, Human Resource Management, Enterprise Strategic Management, Finance Management Internship Human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree. Future Career Graduates can engage in the field of human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise.

duration.text: The Business Administration at Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) A copy of passport (the original passport will be checked during registration)2) One passport-size photo (35mm*50mm)3) Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4) Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2. Be Healthy.3. Under the age of 304. Have attained a senior high school diploma with good marks.5. Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China.6. Good English reading, writing and speaking skills.
